findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Raise: Security. `from_body` accepts any finite number, including `1e308`, and its exception handler omits `OverflowError`. A pull request author can place that value in a review timing; `merged()` passes it to `item()`, where `timedelta(seconds=seconds)` overflows. Reading the editable PR record then crashes `forge board` or `forge next`.
findings.title: A finite duration in a PR record can crash board and next

findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Item 12 still lacks the corrected approved-but-unstarted count, blocking plan problems in Needs you, pinned folding sections with story keys and cold-read history, and rounded pane times. The story assigns these behaviors to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE; this branch retains the old count derivation and page.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Security. `from_body` accepts a finite duration such as `1e308`. Its validation calls `merged()`, which passes that value to `timedelta(seconds=seconds)`; the resulting `OverflowError` is not caught here. A PR author can edit the shared record so `forge board` and `forge next` fail when they read it.
findings.title: A finite duration in a pull request record can crash board and next

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. On a repeat close that hits a default-branch conflict, this call publishes a fabricated `reviewing` result with no findings or evidence. `_publish` replaces the PR's managed block, so an existing blocked review loses its findings and proof list and appears to be running after close has stopped.
findings.title: A merge conflict replaces an existing PR's review and proof

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. The board passes the story start and part/read intervals to `time_records.story`, but supplies no completion bound when `unfinished` is false. `forge story done` can record the outcome after the last part merges; that intervening time is omitted from the story's unknown seconds and total. The runway test covers an unfinished story only.
findings.title: Completed stories omit elapsed time after their last part

stop.reason: Owner rule for Harm 1-2: finding 1 is already guarded (every record row is checked to be a dict); findings 2 and 4 are outside the Done-when with Harm 2 or less and are follow-ups: republish the saved review on a merge conflict; give done stories a finished point; keep the PR time record to summaries
